newsitem.title: USA: Patriot American sets $1.4 bln credit deal.
newsitem.headline: Patriot American sets $1.4 bln credit deal.

text.p: Patriot American Hospitality Inc said on Monday that it has commitments for up to $1.4 billion in revolving credit and term loan facilities.
PaineWebber Real Estate Securities Inc, Citicorp Real Estate Inc, Merrill Lynch Capital Corp and Bankers Trust Co comprise the lending syndicate, Patriot American said.

Patriot American said it is using the credit facility to repay existing debt and finance cash payments for the acquisition of Wyndham Hotel Corp and of 11 hotels from partnerships affliated with the Trammell Crow family.
The credit facilities are structured as a $600 million revolving credit facility and up to $800 million in term loans, Patriot American said.
Of the $800 million in term loans, $200 million will be designated solely for cash payments in connection with the Wyndham acquisition and related hotel acquisitions, Patriot American said.

Patriot American said the credit facilities will be secured by its assets. The credit facilities will bear interest at variable rates based on spreads over the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR), the real estate investmnet trust said.
Commitments to fund the various credit facilities is subject to certain conditions, including completion of due diligence, Patriot American said.
